item.title: Obituary - Helen Newton
item.description: Helen Louise (Scott) Newton, 77, Nevada, MO passed away on Friday, January 23, 2026 at Cox Medical Center South in Springfield, MO. Helen was born September 8, 1948 in Nevada to Leo William and Ruby (Hill) Scott. Helen grew up in Nevada and graduated from Nevada High School Class of 1966. She was an LPN and worked at several area nursing homes and retired from Heartland Hospital in Nevada. She enjoyed crocheting and collecting roosters. item.title: Obituary - Rocky McNeece
item.description: Rocky Allen McNeece, Sr., 65, passed away on Sunday, January 25, 2025 at his home in Nevada, MO. He was born on December 17, 1960 in Milo, MO to Earl Guy McNeece and Mildred Beatrice (Fleener) McNeece. Rocky was raised in Milo. He attended school in Nevada and graduated from Nevada High School in 1979. Shortly after graduating he went to work at Crane Plumbing and was there for over 30 years until its closing in 2013. item.title: Obituary - Jerel Lynn Pankratz
item.description: Jerel Lynn Pankratz, born December 8, 1956, in Hillsboro, Kansas. He went to be with the Lord January 20, 2026. He was a devoted family man, farmer, and lifelong steward of the land. He was born to Allen and Dorothy Pankratz and was raised with strong values of faith, hard work, and service to others.Jerel was a farmer and livestock man at heart. item.title: Obituary - Brittany Hawkins
item.description: Brittany Hawkins, age 36, of Clinton, Missouri passed away on Saturday, January 24, 2026 at St. Luke's Plaza in Kansas City, Missouri. There are no services at this time. Memorial contributions can be made to Brittnay's Memorial Fund and may be left in care of the funeral home.Arrangements have been entrusted to Vansant-Mills Funeral Home in Clinton, Missouri.
